name: DisequalityDispersion.Menger.isChain_erase_or_mem
typeText:
∀ {α : Type} [inst : DecidableEq.{1} α] (E : Finset.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} α α)) (e : Prod.{0, 0} α α) (l : List.{0} α),
  List.IsChain.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Menger.Adj E) l →
    Or (List.IsChain.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Menger.Adj (Finset.erase.{0} E e)) l)
      (And (Membership.mem.{0, 0} l e.1) (Membership.mem.{0, 0} l e.2))

source.code:
theorem isChain_erase_or_mem [DecidableEq α] (E : Finset (α × α)) (e : α × α) :
    ∀ (l : List α), l.IsChain (Adj E) → l.IsChain (Adj (E.erase e)) ∨ (e.1 ∈ l ∧ e.2 ∈ l)
  | [], _ => Or.inl List.IsChain.nil
  | [a], _ => Or.inl (List.isChain_singleton a)
  | a :: b :: l, h => by
      rw [List.isChain_cons_cons] at h
      obtain ⟨hab, hl⟩ := h
      rcases isChain_erase_or_mem E e (b :: l) hl with hl' | ⟨h1, h2⟩
      · by_cases he : (a, b) = e
        · right
          subst he
          simp
        · left
          rw [List.isChain_cons_cons]
          exact ⟨Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨he, hab⟩, hl'⟩
      · right
        exact ⟨List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h1, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h2⟩
